name: PatchX Freenote
description: 首次使用时引导浏览器登录授权，随后查询录音总结、记忆、额度和 AI 整理结果，将记录整理成可复制的笔记。
description_zh: 首次使用时引导浏览器登录授权，随后查询录音总结、记忆、额度和 AI 整理结果，将记录整理成可复制的笔记。
description_en: Sign in through your browser, then read recording summaries, memories, quota and AI results, and turn records into copyable notes.
examples_zh: 帮我登录并连接 PatchX Freenote，打开浏览器让我完成授权，然后检查连接是否成功。
帮我查看最近的手机端录音总结；如果尚未登录，请先引导我完成授权。
帮我把最近一次手机端录音总结整理成可复制的笔记；如果尚未登录，请先引导我完成授权。
examples_en: Connect me to PatchX Freenote, open the browser for authorization if needed, and verify the connection.
Show my recent mobile recording summaries; help me authorize first if I am not signed in.
Turn my latest mobile recording summary into a copyable note; help me authorize first if I am not signed in.
